dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number. IV. A near-polynomial bound for…
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every forest $H$, there exists $c > 0$ such that $\chi(G) \leq \omega(G)^c$ for every $H$-free graph $G$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This polynomial $\chi$-boundedness conjecture for forest-free graphs is described as beautiful and still open; it has been proved only for a smaller collection of forests and has not been settled for any tree containing $P_5$. Showing it for $H = P_5$ would imply the Erdős-Hajnal conjecture for $P_5$.
